seats.school: Kenneth P. Dietrich School of Arts and Sciences

records.name: Adam Leibovich
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean for Research and Faculty Development, Dietrich School
records.notes: Named dean-elect April 26, 2023; deanship effective July 1, 2023. Physics professor and former director of the Pittsburgh Quantum Institute.

records.name: Kathleen Blee
records.priorTitle: Distinguished Professor of Sociology / Associate Dean
records.notes: Announced in 2022 her intention to step down and return to faculty; served as dean since 2017.

seats.school: School of Public and International Affairs

records.name: Amaney Jamal
records.priorTitle: Edwards S. Sanford Professor of Politics
records.notes: Named dean of the (renamed) Princeton School of Public and International Affairs, effective September 1, 2021.

records.name: Cecilia Rouse
records.priorTitle: Professor of Economics and Public Affairs
records.notes: Dean of the Woodrow Wilson School of Public and International Affairs from 2012 until nominated in Nov 2020 to chair the Council of Economic Advisers under President Biden; departed early 2021.

records.name: Christina Paxson
records.priorTitle: Professor of Economics and Public Affairs; Faculty Associate
records.notes: Dean of the Woodrow Wilson School until resigning in 2012 to become president of Brown University. Anne Case served as interim dean during the transition.

records.name: Christopher Yeomans
records.priorTitle: Head, Department of Philosophy
records.notes: Selected as Justin S. Morrill Dean of the College of Liberal Arts after a national search launched in May 2025; appointment took effect December 8, 2025. Philosophy faculty member since 2009, department head since 2017.

records.name: Joel Elbarb
records.notes: Served as interim dean of the College of Liberal Arts during the national search following Reingold's departure.

records.name: David A. Reingold
records.priorTitle: Professor and Executive Associate Dean, School of Public & Environmental Affairs
records.notes: Dean effective March 1, 2015. Left Purdue in 2025 to become chancellor of Indiana University Bloomington.

records.name: Kathleen Canning
records.priorTitle: Chair, Department of History
records.notes: Joined Rice as Dean of Humanities in January 2018; now serves as Dean of the School of Humanities (renamed School of Humanities and Arts).

records.name: Lora Wildenthal
records.priorTitle: Professor of History
records.notes: Served as interim dean of humanities from July 1 to December 31, 2017, bridging Shumway's departure and Canning's arrival.

records.name: Nicolas Shumway
records.priorTitle: Chair, Department of Spanish and Portuguese
records.notes: Appointed dean of humanities effective July 1, 2010; completed seven years as dean.

seats.school: College of Arts, Sciences and Engineering

records.name: Samuel Thomas
records.notes: Named Robert L. and Mary L. Sproull Dean of the School of Arts & Sciences on September 10, 2025; official start January 1, 2026. Following the October 2024 dissolution of the unified College of Arts, Sciences and Engineering, the University of Rochester now maintains separate School of Arts & Sciences and Hajim School of Engineering & Applied Sciences deanships; this record tracks the Arts & Sciences line as the successor seat.

records.name: Duje Tadin
records.priorTitle: Professor / Associate Dean
records.notes: Served as interim dean of the School of Arts & Sciences following the 2024 restructuring and Nicole Sampson's move to the provost's office, until Samuel Thomas's arrival.

records.name: Nicole Sampson
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Appointed dean of the School of Arts & Sciences effective August 7, 2023, succeeding Gloria Culver; later became University of Rochester Provost. Note: Donald Hall (from Lehigh University) separately held the overarching Robert L. and Mary L. Sproull Dean of the Faculty of Arts, Sciences & Engineering role from 2018, and Jeffrey Runner led the undergraduate 'College' (succeeding Richard Feldman) from 2017 until that College-level deanship was dissolved in 2024.

seats.school: School of Arts and Sciences (New Brunswick)

records.name: Peter March
records.priorTitle: Divisional Dean of Natural and Mathematical Sciences, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Appointed Executive Dean of the School of Arts and Sciences effective July 1, 2014; announced May 15, 2014. Continues to serve as of 2024-2025.

records.name: Donna J. LaVoie
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean / Associate Dean
records.notes: Served as interim dean beginning in 2020 and was named permanent dean effective July 1, 2023, after nearly 30 years on the SLU psychology faculty and multiple prior academic leadership roles in the college.

records.name: Donna J. LaVoie
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Interim dean beginning 2020 before being converted to permanent dean in 2023; predecessor as permanent dean not confirmed in sources reviewed.

records.name: Todd Butler
records.notes: Current dean of the College of Arts and Letters; began his tenure around August 2020 based on anniversary references. Exact appointment announcement and prior title not confirmed in sources reviewed.

seats.school: Dana and David Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences

records.name: James Bullock
records.notes: Named dean of USC Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences, succeeding Amber Miller, with his term beginning July 1.

records.name: Amber Miller
records.priorTitle: Experimental Astrophysicist / Dean of Science
records.notes: Installed in 2016 as the 22nd dean of USC Dornsife; the longest-serving dean at the college since the 1950s, with nearly eight years in the role.

records.name: Howard Gillman
records.priorTitle: Professor of Political Science, History, and Law
records.notes: Appointed the 20th Dean of USC Dornsife in 2007; left to become Chancellor of UC Irvine in 2012. Peter Starr served as interim dean 2006-2007 prior to Gillman; dean(s) between Gillman's 2012 departure and Miller's 2016 arrival not confirmed in sources reviewed.

records.name: Sam Holland
records.priorTitle: Professor of Music
records.notes: Current Algur H. Meadows Dean and Professor of Music at the Meadows School of the Arts. Exact appointment year and predecessor could not be confirmed from sources reviewed; recent 2015 MTNA Teacher of the Year award suggests tenure predates 2015.

seats.school: McCausland College of Arts and Sciences

records.name: Christopher Culbertson
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Named dean April 2026; assumes the role July 1, 2026, succeeding the interim leadership that followed Lacy Ford's departure. Was dean at Kansas State since 2023.

records.name: Joel Samuels
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Became interim dean January 1, 2021, after Lacy Ford stepped down; led the college (renamed McCausland College of Arts and Sciences) through the search that resulted in Culbertson's hiring.

records.name: Lacy Ford
records.priorTitle: Vice Provost and Dean of Undergraduate Studies
records.notes: Dean of the College of Arts and Sciences from 2016 until stepping down in spring 2021 to return to research and teaching.

records.name: Elizabeth Spiller
records.priorTitle: Executive Vice Chancellor and Chief Academic Officer
records.notes: Serving as dean since July 9, 2024. Previously spent three years as dean of the College of Letters and Science at UC Davis before Nebraska. Predecessor as USF Tampa CAS dean not confirmed in sources reviewed (note: this college is distinct from the former USF St. Petersburg College of Arts and Sciences, led by Frank Biafora 2007-2018, which was consolidated into ONE USF).

records.name: Benjamin Bricker and Jennifer Smith
records.notes: Serving as Co-Acting Interim Deans of the College of Liberal Arts as of the 2026-2027 academic year. Name and dates of the most recent permanent dean could not be confirmed in sources reviewed.

records.name: Debra Satz
records.priorTitle: Senior Associate Dean for the Humanities and Arts
records.notes: Current Vernon R. and Lysbeth Warren Anderson Dean of the School of Humanities and Sciences; served as senior associate dean for humanities and arts 2010-2017 before becoming dean upon Richard Saller's 2017 departure. Marta Sutton Weeks Professor of Ethics in Society and professor of philosophy.

records.name: Richard Saller
records.priorTitle: Provost
records.notes: Classical historian appointed Vernon R. and Lysbeth Warren Anderson Dean in 2007; served 10 years, stepping down in 2017. Later became Stanford's 12th president in 2023.

records.name: Sharon Long
records.priorTitle: Professor of Biological Sciences
records.notes: Appointed inaugural Vernon R. and Lysbeth Warren Anderson Dean of the School of Humanities and Sciences in 2001.

records.name: David Wrobel
records.priorTitle: Dean, Dodge Family College of Arts and Sciences (David L. Boren Professor)
records.notes: Renowned scholar of American history; became dean and Professor of History at Stony Brook after Axel Drees's interim term. Exact start date not confirmed in sources reviewed, but followed the 2023-24 search for Nicole Sampson's successor.

records.name: Axel Drees
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean for Budget and Operations, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Named interim dean June 22, 2023, replacing outgoing dean Nicole Sampson while a permanent search was conducted. Had previously served as Acting Dean of CAS in summer 2011 and Associate Dean for Budget and Operations 2008-2012.

records.name: Nicole Sampson
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean, College of Arts and Sciences; Chair, Department of Chemistry
records.notes: Joined Stony Brook in 1993 as assistant professor of chemistry; chaired the department 2012-2017 and served as CAS associate dean before becoming dean. Left Stony Brook in 2023 to become dean of the School of Arts & Sciences at the University of Rochester. Exact start year as Stony Brook dean not confirmed in sources reviewed.
